scripts.build: bun run build:base && bun run build:adapters && bun run build:frameworks
scripts.build:base: bun run --filter @supermetry/tracker build && bun run --filter @supermetry/node build && bun run --filter @supermetry/react-native build
scripts.build:adapters: bun run --filter @supermetry/react build && bun run --filter @supermetry/vue build && bun run --filter @supermetry/astro build && bun run --filter @supermetry/express build
scripts.build:frameworks: bun run --filter @supermetry/nextjs build && bun run --filter @supermetry/remix build
